entry.title: GameSpot: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment Hands-On Preview
entry.summary:
Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment Hands-On Preview
The latest Musou-style Zelda spin-off, Age of Imprisonment, has officially joined the series’ canon—meaning those over-the-top battles now actually impact the wider Legend of Zelda timeline. Expect familiar characters, epic boss brawls, and a few surprise twists that tie directly into Hyrule’s established lore. With its canon status, the game introduces brand-new mechanics that feel right at home in the Zelda universe—think dynamic stage events, weapon upgrades that evolve alongside Link, and special “story battles” that give longtime fans some juicy narrative payoffs. It’s classic musou chaos… but with a Zelda-shaped twist. Watch on YouTube

entry.summary:
Ghost of Yōtei Review
Ghost of Yōtei hands you the reins to Atsu, a fresh-faced protagonist driven by a thirst for revenge. From the opening moments, you’re swept into a tale that’s as emotionally charged as it is action-packed. Set against the lush yet blood-soaked tapestries of Feudal Japan, the game thrives on its stunning contrasts—serene shrines one moment, brutal skirmishes the next. It’s a wild ride that balances beauty and violence like a razor’s edge. Watch on YouTube
